SELECT B.NO ,B.TITLE ,B.CONTENT ,B.CATEGORY_NO ,B.WRITER_NO ,B.HIT ,B.CREATE_DATE ,B.DEL_YN ,M.NICK AS WRITER_NICK ,C.NAME AS CATEGORY_NAME FROM BOARD B JOIN MEMBER M ON (B.WRITER_NO = M.NO) JOIN CATEGORY C ON (B.CATEGORY_NO = C.NO) WHERE B.DEL_YN = 'N'
AND TITLE LIKE '%${searchValue}%'
